hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" 2>/dev/null && PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" bun run office open >/dev/null 2>&1
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" 2>/dev/null && PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" bun run office emit-hook >/dev/null 2>&1
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" 2>/dev/null && PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH" bun run office reset >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '{}'
